name: nordiccontacts
description: Find decision-makers in your target audience across Finland, Sweden and Estonia — verified B2B company and contact data through the NordicContacts MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
Find decision-makers in your target audience across Finland, Sweden and Estonia. NordicContacts gives ChatGPT read-only access to verified B2B company and contact data: find companies by name, website domain, or business ID; count companies or contacts in a market segment before building a list; and retrieve decision-maker contacts with names, titles, and direct email addresses and phone numbers for prospecting.

Connecting requires a NordicContacts account and OAuth sign-in. Retrieval tools return company or contact records for the connected account; segment retrieval returns up to 100 records per call with offset pagination for larger segments.

All tools are read-only: the plugin cannot modify data and cannot create files. Larger exports are handled on nordiccontacts.eu.
capabilities: Find companies by name, domain, or business ID
Count companies and contacts in market segments
Look up a contact by email address
defaultPrompt: How many companies in Finland operate in logistics?
Which Finnish company uses the domain dynava.com?

positive.description: Count companies in a Finnish industry segment
positive.prompt: How many companies in Finland operate in software development?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the industry filter and returns a numeric count of matching Finnish companies.

positive.prompt: List 5 contacts with CEO or managing director responsibilities at companies in Sweden.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 5 contact rows with person and company fields, noting the balance cost.

positive.prompt: Which Finnish company uses the domain dynava.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the resolved company (Dynava Oy) with its name, business ID, and details.

positive.description: List contacts at a named company
positive.prompt: Show up to 3 contacts working at Dynava.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Dynava Oy and returns its available contact rows (up to 3) with names and titles.

positive.prompt: Find the Finnish company named Dynava.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the resolved company or ranked candidates with match scores.

negative.description: Unsupported write operation: all tools are read-only, so the plugin must refuse to modify or delete records.
negative.prompt: Delete the company Dynava from your database.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that NordicContacts data access is read-only and does not delete or modify anything.

negative.description: Out-of-coverage geography: the database covers only Finland, Sweden, and Estonia.
negative.prompt: Find decision-maker contacts at companies in Norway.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that coverage is limited to Finland, Sweden, and Estonia and returns no records.

negative.description: Bulk file export is not a tool capability and must not be simulated.
negative.prompt: Export all contacts in Sweden to an Excel file.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it cannot create files and points to Excel exports on nordiccontacts.eu instead.

review.commerce_description: The plugin itself does not sell products or process payments; subscriptions and prepaid balance are managed on nordiccontacts.eu.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: 17 read-only MCP tools for B2B company search, contact lookup, and segment counts covering Finland, Sweden, and Estonia.

fi-FI.subtitle: Löydä kohderyhmäsi päättäjät
fi-FI.description: Löydä kohderyhmäsi päättäjät Suomesta, Ruotsista ja Virosta. NordicContacts antaa ChatGPT:lle lukuoikeuden varmistettuihin B2B-yritys- ja yhteystietoihin: etsi yrityksiä, laske segmenttikoot ja hae päättäjien yhteystiedot. Käyttö edellyttää NordicContacts-tiliä ja OAuth-kirjautumista.

sv-SE.subtitle: Hitta beslutsfattare
sv-SE.description: Hitta beslutsfattare i din målgrupp i Finland, Sverige och Estland. NordicContacts ger ChatGPT läsbar åtkomst till verifierade B2B-företags- och kontaktdata: hitta företag, räkna segmentstorlekar och hämta kontaktuppgifter. Kräver NordicContacts-konto och OAuth-inloggning.
